subject: User manual for MC-12 microcentrifuge
body:
Dear Northfield team,

We have recently taken delivery of two MC-12 microcentrifuges for our teaching lab. Could you please send us a PDF copy of the user manual? The printed copies seem to have gone missing during unpacking.

Kind regards,
Priya Raman
Purchasing Manager, School of Biosciences
Northbridge University
notes: Baseline positive: manual sent without asking the version. Optional context, not graded: Manual covers both MC-12 versions; no version question needed.

subject: AB-220 manual
body:
Hi,

can you email me the manual for the AB-220 balance please? Need it for our equipment folder.

Thanks
Tom

parts.label: Product documentation request
reply_must_state: Revision R3 named in the reply

subject: hb2 instructions??
body: need the latest instructions for the HB-2 heater asap, new starter on monday. cheers

parts.label: Product documentation request
reply_must_state: Current revision sent

notes: Unknown sender; identity not required for documents.

subject: Spec sheet – MC-12 Plus

Adebayo Adeyemi
Biomedical Scientist, Calder Valley Pathology Services

Marcus Bellamy
Lab Manager, Department of Chemistry, Eastgate University

Best,
Ben Aldous
Director, Meridian BioAnalytics

parts.label: Product documentation request
reply_must_state: The attached certificate is a sample, labelled as such
The unit's own certificate is being handled by our quality team

Grace Okafor

Piotr Nowak

Thank you,
Lucía
